title: Uniqueness of the normalized derived scalar tensor comparison
statement: The normalization on resolving K-flat representatives determines every component after localization. Joint conservativity of those representatives and extensionality of natural isomorphisms identify any two normalized comparisons.

source.place: Tags 06YY and 07A4, derived scalar/tensor descent and normalization

proof.text: Restriction of natural transformations to pairs of flat-term K-flat complexes is faithful, using tensorRepresentatives_fullyFaithful from the existing pro-etale descent-data proof.

For each resolving pair, extract the two stipulated normalization equalities. Proof irrelevance identifies the target representative proofs, so their right sides coincide. The source representative map is invertible, and the two scalar counits are invertible by K-flat counit computation. Cancel these maps and the image of their product under the target tensor functor.

The two hom components therefore agree on every resolving pair. Faithfulness of restriction gives equality of the natural transformations, and isomorphism extensionality gives equality of the comparisons.
